functions.name: ROUND
functions.description: One cell's share of a consistently rounded group: the rounded values add up to the rounded total.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: The whole group of numbers being rounded together, as a range reference.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Which cell of the range this is, counting from 1.

parameters.name: decimals
parameters.description: Decimal places, as in ROUND: 0 for whole numbers, negative for tens and thousands.

functions.name: ROUNDSUM
functions.description: The group's total, rounded so it equals the sum of PLSFIX.ROUND over the same range.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: The whole group of numbers being rounded together, as a range reference.

parameters.name: decimals
parameters.description: Decimal places, as in ROUND: 0 for whole numbers, negative for tens and thousands.

functions.name: CAGR
functions.description: The compound annual growth rate from a first value to a last one over a number of periods.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: The value at the start of the first period.

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: The value at the end of the last period.

parameters.name: periods
parameters.description: How many periods the growth ran over, usually years. At least one.
